about.title: I design architectures that bridge data and decisions.
about.desc1: I am an Information and Communication Technology (ICT) student at Rangsit University International College based in Bangkok, Thailand. I specialize in Database Design, Data Engineering, and Data Analytics, with a strong foundation in building interactive analytical interfaces, distributed storage systems, and advanced data simulations. I am currently seeking an internship to apply my data expertise to real-world engineering challenges.
about.desc2: My academic projects—ranging from designing optimized relational database models to simulating complex viral agent interactions—have shaped my technical philosophy: turning raw data into structured pipelines and actionable insights.
about.focusDesc: Designing robust database architectures & scalable data pipelines.

projects.title: Selected Projects

items.title: AuraVision: Advanced Assistive Vision System (SmartAV)
items.desc: A real-time assistive technology for visually impaired users. Leverages AI-driven Computer Vision (YOLOE-26N-seg, FaceNet) and LlamaIndex RAG over ChromaDB to provide environmental awareness, hazard tracking, and temporal spatial memory.

items.title: golf-bookr: Schema & Reservation Engine
items.desc: An interactive reservation platform designed with a highly optimized database schema, managing real-time booking availability, relational user associations, and robust transaction concurrency.

items.title: TikTok ABM: Agent-Based Data Simulator
items.desc: A simulation framework built in Python to model and analyze user interactions, content recommendation algorithms, and viral network dynamics on the TikTok platform.

items.title: HDFS: Distributed Storage Explorer
items.desc: An analytical visualizer designed to simulate distributed storage filesystems, modeling chunk replication, NameNode operations, and distributed data pipelines.

items.title: Fraud-Detection: Transaction Anomaly Classifier
items.desc: A machine learning data pipeline designed to preprocess large financial datasets, perform feature engineering, and classify fraudulent transactions using ensemble anomaly detection models.
